name: Collect-A-Con Fort Lauderdale
blurb: Miami-Fort Lauderdale stop of the multi-city Collect-A-Con tour: trading cards, pop-culture collectibles, cosplay and celebrity autograph signings at the Broward County Convention Center.
notes: Organizer's own name for this stop is 'Miami-Fort Lauderdale' (Broward County Convention Center, Fort Lauderdale). The evergreen /miami/ URL currently redirects to the homepage with nothing city-specific scheduled; the dated page 'Miami 2026 Recap' ('Thank you for attending! See you next year.') confirms that edition already completed. Checked the site's XML sitemap for any schedule/tour page or 2027-dated URL across the whole domain and found none, so no next date is announced. Exact last-edition dates (Feb 21-22, 2026) are not restated on the official recap page itself (title only) but are corroborated by several independent event-listing sites (animecons.com, fancons.com, rostercon.com). No Fort-Lauderdale-specific key art exists on the site: the recap template's own og image and hero carousel are a generic crowd photo and a cross-promo for the next tour stop (Dallas), so the cover falls back to the national tour logo used on the main collectaconusa.com homepage.
